description: In Eclipse ThreadX NetX Duo versions 6.0 through 6.5.2.202603a, the FTP client in IPv4 passive mode opens its data connection to whatever address the server names in its 227 reply instead of the server it is talking to. A malicious FTP server can make the client connect to any host and port the device can reach, using it to scan the internal network and to deliver uploads to internal services.
